entries.source: Jaune/BLS.lean:100: |x| = 0xd201000000010000, py_ecc ate_loop_count; the BLS12-381 parameter x is negative (G2Subgroup.lean:6, draft-irtf-cfrg-pairing-friendly-curves-11 4.2.1), so the value is the magnitude of the Miller loop scalar. N2 review of the G2b map (Plans g2-plan/n2-g2b-review/review.md, master check and ruling R23, user decision 2026-11-22), MISLEADING 1.

Jaune/BLS.lean:103: 62, the bit index where the descending Miller loop starts (BLS.lean:160, 353); the top set bit of |x| is 63 and initialises the loop. py_ecc log_ate_loop_count.
